designAssetsPolicy: Approved screenshots guide visual style only; they are not market imagery or production UI data.
compatibilityNote: v1.7 adds explicit demo-only resolutionRule, chartPoints, liquidity and activity; v1.6 financial seed values are retained.

simulationRules.marketClock: Frozen at displayAsOf; no real-time updates.
simulationRules.orderExecution: Immediate: full fill or reject at scenario ask/bid; limit: OPEN until explicit deterministic scenario event or cancelled.
simulationRules.fees: 0 cents; display Demo fees $0; do not reuse fees from generated images.
simulationRules.liquidityPolicy: maxImmediateBuyContractsPerOutcome/maxImmediateSellContractsPerOutcome snapshot cap, not a real order book
simulationRules.markingPolicy: mark positions at indicative price; sale preview uses bid and cannot guarantee later execution
simulationRules.copyrightPolicy: Do not attribute fabricated headlines to real publishers; images are layout references not licensed production assets.

portfolio-ready.description: Four open positions, one pending limit BUY, three saved markets; accounting totals match initialState

fresh-start.description: Keep all market fixture prices; reset user account to $1,000 virtual cash and zero positions/orders/history/saved/notifications

pending-order.description: Select the seeded 20 contract BUY YES LIMIT at 22 cents on apple-foldable-2027; it is OPEN until explicitly cancelled

market-suspended.description: Set the Mars market to SUSPENDED for an explicit demo test; no new orders allowed; retain holdings/history

resolved-market.description: Open the already-resolved demo summit, show YES result and rules, block trading. No cash adjustment because seed has no position in this market

price-change-before-confirm.description: When reviewing BUY YES on Mars, tester explicitly simulates a price change; do not execute stale order; ask for new Review

limited-liquidity.description: Override max immediate fill on Mars for testing full reject (no P0 partial fills)
